AXIOM · qeva:1:excluded-middle@1

Law of excluded middle

For every statement P, classical logic admits P or not-P.

editoriallogic · foundations
Trace this conceptSearch connections

PLAIN

The idea

For every statement P, classical logic admits P or not-P.

EXACT

The compact statement

The schema P∨¬P is derivable or postulated in classical systems. It is not generally derivable in intuitionistic logic.

Example

Applied to a proposition about an integer, it permits case analysis into P and ¬P even without a decision procedure.

Boundary / caveat

Logical acceptance is framework-relative; QEVA records the branch instead of calling alternative logics defective.

Assumptions

  • The declared classical logic context is fixed.
